news.fullDescription: Manga creator Keigo Maki (Kawaii dake ja Nai Shikimori-san) will draw a manga adaptation of Type-Moon's Mahoutsukai no Yoru (Witch on the Holy Night) visual novel, the official X (formerly Twitter) account of the manga announced on Tuesday. The series will begin serialization in Weekly Shounen Magazine's 50th issue on November 11. Kinoko Nasu (Fate/stay night) and Type-Moon are credited for the original work, while Hirokazu Koyama (22/7) is credited for the original character designs....
